The following Guides and Vignettes are available:

 - [Quick-Start Guide](b_quickstart.qmd): The Quick-Start Guide is the first thing to read for new users, and gives a brief explanation on how to use the 'broadcast' package, without getting lost in the details.
 - [Prerequisites and Installation](installation.qmd): This guide explains the requirements to use the 'broadcast' package, and how to install it.
 - [Functions Overview](functions.qmd): This guide simply lists the functions available in the broadcast package.
 - [Broadcasting Explained](broadcasting_explained.qmd): This Guide gives a very detailed explanation of how exactly broadcasting works in the 'broadcast' package. Read this *after* you've read the Quick-Start Guide.
 -  [List Casting Explained](casting_explained.qmd): This Guide gives a detailed explanation of how casting nested lists to dimensional lists and vice-versa works in the 'broadcast' package.
 - [Practical Applications](practical_applications.qmd): This Guide gives some practical applications wherein the broadcasted methods might be used.
 - [Technical Details](technical_details.qmd): This Guide gives some technical details; not relevant for the average use.
